Discrete is the standard choice; Karras pairs with the DPM++ family; LCM goes with the LCM sampler
Euler a is the safest all-rounder; LCM / TCD are the few-step acceleration samplers for LoRA; DPM++ 2M gives more detail but is slower
GGUF runs on CPU for now (this runtime has no GPU backend)
LCM-LoRA is a tens-of-MB \"distillation patch\". Attached to the main model it cuts 20 steps down to 4-8 (~5x faster) without touching the model file.
LoRA downloaded — tick \"LoRA accel\" on the Draw page

Ponko — from the Japanese ポンコツ, meaning a useless lump of junk. Not much of a brain, but you can swap in the best model whenever you like.\nAll models and inference run offline on this device; chat history is stored locally only.
